# Igor Khrol — Head of Data Engineering

> Head of Data Engineering at Automattic (WordPress.com, Tumblr, WooCommerce).
> 20 years in engineering: quality engineering leadership → data platforms → AI enablement.
> Two-time IMO silver medalist (International Mathematical Olympiad, 2003 & 2004).
> Vilnius, Lithuania · khroliz@gmail.com · https://www.linkedin.com/in/khroliz · https://github.com/Khrol

## Experience

### Head of Data Engineering — Automattic (2022-03 – present)

Leading Automattic's data engineering team — the engineers behind the central
self-hosted data platform powering analytics and AI across WordPress.com,
Tumblr, and WooCommerce.

- Lead a team of 5–7 data-platform engineers owning the company's central self-hosted data platform (Spark, Trino, Airflow, Kafka, Apache Iceberg, Superset, Looker, JupyterHub) — roadmap, planning, reviews, and production operations.
- Set the team's AI-enablement strategy and led its delivery across the team: a program of MCP servers (Trino, Superset, Looker, data catalog) giving LLM agents governed access to company data; defined the next phase — AI evaluation, observability, and domain-scoped data assistants.
- Designed data-access governance for AI agents: least-privilege, tag-based, read-only warehouse access enforced with policy-as-code (Open Policy Agent).
- Put LLM evaluation into CI: an LLM-as-judge harness verifying documentation produces correct AI-agent behavior ("TDD for docs").
- Coordinated the team's migration of the warehouse to Apache Iceberg — the platform's move to an open lakehouse table format — while personally contributing 50+ merged improvements on Iceberg reliability, snapshot retention, and storage optimization.
- Drove a data-contract integrity program on Apache Iceberg: automated contract-violation checks, fixes to billion-row production tables, and major storage and compute cost optimizations.
- Represent the data platform across the company: AI data-tooling and access-policy decisions, security collaboration (member of the security incident response team), and the editorial group of Automattic's public data blog.
- Still hands-on: one of the platform's top contributors with 2,000+ merged changes; led every major Airflow production upgrade, through Airflow 3.

Technologies: Trino, Spark, Airflow, Kafka, Apache Iceberg, Scala, Python, Superset, Looker, JupyterHub, Open Policy Agent, MCP

### Senior Data Engineer — Automattic (2019-02 – 2022-03)

- Core engineer of the data platform from its early days: introduced Airflow to the company in 2019 and later drove the Airflow 2.0 migration.
- Designed a self-service SQL transformation framework that removed a 5-engineer bottleneck: 50+ people across the company now contribute 700+ production data transformations (https://data.blog/2021/02/22/sql-a-common-language-for-the-whole-data-team/).
- Implemented data retention and deletion at the core product-analytics event store (GDPR-driven).
- Migrated the platform from Cloudera Hadoop to a Docker-based on-premises stack; established CI/CD, quality gates, and static code analysis in the data org.

### Team/Tech Lead in Analytics — Toptal (2015-04 – 2018-03)

- Led data engineering and ML topics in the Analytics department — ETL platform, data warehouse, and production ML services.
- Shipped ML microservices to production on Google App Engine (Python, scikit-learn).
- Migrated analytics infrastructure to Google Cloud (BigQuery, GAE, GCE), cutting infrastructure and maintenance costs.
- Embedded quality into the development process and shortened CI/CD feedback loops.

Technologies: Scala, Spark, Python, Pandas, Luigi, scikit-learn, Google Cloud, Ruby on Rails, Postgres

### Test Automation Lead — Wargaming (2013-12 – 2015-05)

- Built the Web department's test-automation capability from scratch — technology, process, hiring, and infrastructure — at a gaming company with 100M+ registered players.
- Ran a company-wide test-automation community connecting projects, departments, and regional offices.
- Drove a shift-left test strategy, moving the bulk of automation from UI to API and unit tests.
- Authored open-source testing libraries webium (https://github.com/wgnet/webium) and grail (https://github.com/wgnet/grail), published on PyPI under the Wargaming GitHub org.

### Automated Testing Consultant — Tele2 (2012-02 – 2013-11)

- Consulted on test-automation development: framework creation and enhancements, process improvements, and training; performance testing.

### Trainer and Consultant — EPAM Systems (2012-03 – 2013-07)

- Delivered Selenium/WebDriver training and consulted delivery teams on test automation.

### Software Testing Team Lead — EPAM Systems (2009-07 – 2012-02)

- Managed a team of 20 engineers supporting UI automation for the Oracle ATG eCommerce product.
- Implemented an open-source-based solution for testing Flex applications.

### QA Specialist — A1QA (2006-04 – 2009-07)

- Led multiple automated and performance-testing projects; automated and performance test scripting.
